win.rule: One column wins at once; the opponent has no immediate win.

block.rule: The opponent can win at one column next turn and the mover cannot win at once: only the block does not lose at once.

fork.rule: No immediate win or threat; exactly one move leaves threats the opponent cannot all stop, and it is the only winning move.

solver.rule: No immediate win, threat or two-move win; exactly one move keeps the result (the only winning move, or the only move that does not lose), by the solver.
